title: Boss Challenge: Materials Engineer
summary: Six real engineering jobs, from house wiring to an aeroplane body. Choose the best material and justify it with properties.

ib.note: Unit summative-style task: applying knowledge (Criterion A) and evaluating choices (Criterion D)

cbse.chapter: Curiosity Ch 4: The World of Metals and Non-metals (uses of metals)

objectives: I can choose a suitable material for a job by matching properties to requirements.
I can justify my choice and explain why other materials are less suitable.
I can consider cost and sustainability as well as properties.
misconceptions: The 'best' material is always the strongest or most expensive.
One material can be perfect for every job.
